ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportTowaryZGrupy' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportTowaryZGrupy;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportTowaryZGrupy] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT @rowVersion+1 AS [@RowVersion] ,(select TwrGidNumer as [@Id], --dodać ID do TwrLinki ???? GidNumer as [@GroupId], TwrGidNumer as [@ProductId] from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid outer apply cdn.PobierzDrzewoGrupTowarowych(PcK_TwGENumer,DEFAULT,DEFAULT,1,DEFAULT,DEFAULT) join cdn.TwrGrupy on TwG_GIDNumer = GidNumer AND TwG_GIDTyp = Gidtyp join cdn.twrlinki on TwL_GrOTyp = Gidtyp and Twl_GroNumer = GidNumer and TwL_Lisc = 1 join cdn.POS_TwrDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) on TwL_GIDNumer = TwrGIDNumer and Twl_Gidtyp = 16 where psa_id = @PointOfSaleId for xml path('ProductsGroup'), type) for xml path('ProductsGroups') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportTowaryZGrupy TO CDNRaport
